name: WebShop
summary: Princeton simulated e-commerce environment and benchmark for grounded language agents shopping from text instructions.
description: Established research environment from the 2022 WebShop paper (princeton-nlp/WebShop), not a new 2026 launch. MIT LICENSE.md verified; GitHub not archived (last push observed 2024-09). Provides a Gym-style web shopping sim with search agents for reproducing paper results. Setup uses Python 3.8+, Java and the repo setup.sh. Model inference and any external site access are separate.

agent_access.notes: Public repository and project site; local environment setup per README.
